flows.purpose: Check the fixed stable release source for an Amadeus update
flows.trigger: consented manual check, at most once per 24 hours unless forced
flows.retention: Only the last-check timestamp and normalized release result are stored locally
flows.revocation: Declining update consent prevents further remote checks

flows.recipient: A separately approved local provider on this computer
flows.purpose: Run an explicitly routed task on a qualified local model
flows.trigger: explicit provider approval plus qualified task routing
flows.retention: Controlled by the local provider; Amadeus records only local qualification and work evidence
flows.revocation: Disabling or unapproving the provider immediately removes routing authority

flows.recipient: The explicitly selected Codex, Cursor or Claude subscription provider
flows.purpose: Execute an owner-authorized task in an isolated workspace
flows.trigger: owner-authorized task delegation and provider selection
flows.retention: Controlled by the selected provider; Amadeus keeps local receipts and verification evidence
flows.revocation: Stopping the goal or disabling the provider prevents later dispatch
